pairs.target: shào lǐ de xiāngzǐ hé bú shàng .
pairs.english: Shaoli's trunk wouldn't close.
pairs.hanzi: 邵里的箱子合不上。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jīngguò qǐnshì ménwài shí , xiān kànjiàn yìzhī xuēzǐ cóng xiāng fènglǐ tànchūlái , suíhòu cái kànjiàn shào lǐ de liǎn .
pairs.english: Passing his room, Tavi saw a boot poking through the gap before he saw Shaoli's face.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维经过寝室门外时，先看见一只靴子从箱缝里探出来，随后才看见邵里的脸。

pairs.target: tā zuòzài xiāng gài shàng , liǎng jiǎo dǐ dì , xiàng yào bǎ zhěngjiān wūzi yìqǐ yājìn xiāngdǐ .
pairs.english: He sat on the lid, feet braced, as though pressing the whole room into the trunk.
pairs.hanzi: 他坐在箱盖上，两脚抵地，像要把整间屋子一起压进箱底。

pairs.target: " bāng wǒ ná yíxià . " tǎ wéi shēnshǒu jiē zhù de shì yìběn hòu cèzǐ .
pairs.english: “Hold this for me.” Tavi took a thick book.
pairs.hanzi:
“帮我拿一下。”
塔维伸手接住的是一本厚册子。

pairs.target: cèzǐ cái chōuchūlái , xiāng gài jiù wǎng xiàluò le yì jié .
pairs.english: As soon as it came out, the lid dropped a little.
pairs.hanzi: 册子才抽出来，箱盖就往下落了一截。

pairs.target: shào lǐ chènjī kòu shàng dākòu , zhàn qǐlái pāilepāi kùzǐ , liǎnshàng què méiyǒu shōushí wán dōngxī de qīngsōng .
pairs.english: Shaoli seized the chance to fasten the catch, stood and brushed his trousers, yet didn't look relieved to have finished packing.
pairs.hanzi: 邵里趁机扣上搭扣，站起来拍了拍裤子，脸上却没有收拾完东西的轻松。

pairs.target: tā míngtiān qù xī qú bào dào .
pairs.english: He reported for work at West Canal tomorrow.
pairs.hanzi: 他明天去西渠报到。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhīdào tā hòulái bǔ le kǎohé , què yìzhí méiyǒu wèn jiéguǒ .
pairs.english: Tavi knew he'd taken the rescheduled assessment, but had never asked the result.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维知道他后来补了考核，却一直没有问结果。

pairs.target: xiànzài cái tīngshuō , shǒu zài chángxiū jiéshù qián yǐjīng chá guò , wòchí búzài suānténg , bǔkǎo yě guò le ;
pairs.english: Only now did he hear the hand had been checked before the break ended: gripping no longer hurt, and he'd passed the retest.
pairs.hanzi: 现在才听说，手在长休结束前已经查过，握持不再酸疼，补考也过了；

pairs.target: chéngnán shuǐzhá de míngé què yǐjīng gěi le biérén .
pairs.english: But the southern sluice place had gone to someone else.
pairs.hanzi: 城南水闸的名额却已经给了别人。

pairs.target: xī qú nàbiān yǒu hézhù de fángjiān , báitiān néng zhù , lún yèbān yě búyòng bān ,
pairs.english: West Canal offered a shared room available by day, with no need to move on changing to night shifts;
pairs.hanzi: 西渠那边有合住的房间，白天能住，轮夜班也不用搬，

pairs.target: zhǐshì chuāngwài liàng mǎn le yīshang , jiàn búdào tā yuánxiān xiǎng kàn de hé .
pairs.english: only laundry filled the view, hiding the river he'd hoped to see.
pairs.hanzi: 只是窗外晾满了衣裳，见不到他原先想看的河。

pairs.target: " nǐ qù kàn le ? " tǎ wéi wèn .
pairs.english: “You went to look?” Tavi asked.
pairs.hanzi: “你去看了？”塔维问。

pairs.target: " kàn le liǎnghuí . dìèrhuí méi rén shōu yīfu , lián duìmiàn de qiáng yě kànbújiàn . "
pairs.english: “Twice. Nobody brought the washing in the second time. Couldn't even see the wall opposite.”
pairs.hanzi: “看了两回。第二回没人收衣服，连对面的墙也看不见。”

pairs.target: tā shuō dé yìběnzhèngjīng , tǎ wéi xiào chūlái , yòu juéde zìjǐ xiào dé bú dà héshì .
pairs.english: He was so serious that Tavi laughed, then wondered whether he should have.
pairs.hanzi: 他说得一本正经，塔维笑出来，又觉得自己笑得不大合适。

pairs.target: shào lǐ què shēnshǒu bǎ xiāng jiǎo nà zhī xuēzǐ sāi zhèng , shuō zǒng bǐ chuānghù gēnběn dǎbùkāi hǎo .
pairs.english: Shaoli straightened the boot in the trunk corner, saying it was better than a window that wouldn't open at all.
pairs.hanzi: 邵里却伸手把箱角那只靴子塞正，说总比窗户根本打不开好。

pairs.target: wūlǐ lìng yígè rén yǎng le yìpén cōng , dāying fēn tā bàngè chuāngtái .
pairs.english: His roommate grew scallions and had promised him half the windowsill.
pairs.hanzi: 屋里另一个人养了一盆葱，答应分他半个窗台。

pairs.target: zhuōshàng liúxià jǐjiàn bù dǎsuàn dàizǒu de dōngxī : yìzhī quēkǒu bēi , jǐzhāng juàn biān de liànxí zhǐ , háiyǒu nà běn tài hòu de cèzǐ .
pairs.english: He'd left things on the table: a chipped cup, curled practice sheets, and the over-thick book.
pairs.hanzi: 桌上留下几件不打算带走的东西：一只缺口杯、几张卷边的练习纸，还有那本太厚的册子。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi fānkāi , fāxiàn jiá yè lǐ huà zhe zìjǐ zuìjìn zhèng bèi zhémó de biǎogé .
pairs.english: Tavi opened it and found the very tables that had lately been tormenting him.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维翻开，发现夹页里画着自己最近正被折磨的表格。

pairs.target: " nǐ yě xué guò zhège ? " " wǒ búhuì cóng chuángshàng cháng chū kǎohéchéngjì . "
pairs.english: “You studied this too?” “My assessment marks didn't grow out of my bed.”
pairs.hanzi:
“你也学过这个？”
“我不会从床上长出考核成绩。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ cèzǐ dìhuíqù , shào lǐ méi jiē , zhī wèn tā shìbushì yào bǔ suànshù .
pairs.english: Tavi offered the book back; Shaoli only asked whether he needed arithmetic catch-up.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把册子递回去，邵里没接，只问他是不是要补算术。

pairs.target: xiāoxī jìng yǐjīng zhuàndào zhèbiān le .
pairs.english: So the news had reached here too.
pairs.hanzi: 消息竟已经传到这边了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǒudiǎn búzìzài , shuō shì wèile nà mén jiù shèshī shítú kè , búshì yuánlái de gōngkè quán bùjígé .
pairs.english: Uneasy, Tavi said it was for the old-infrastructure chart reading, not because he'd failed every regular subject.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维有点不自在，说是为了那门旧设施识图课，不是原来的功课全不及格。

pairs.target: " shuí shuō nǐ quán bùjígé ? " zhè jù huà bǎ tā dǔzhù le .
pairs.english: “Who said you'd failed everything?” That stopped him.
pairs.hanzi:
“谁说你全不及格？”
这句话把他堵住了。

pairs.target: zǒuláng lǐ yǒurén xiào zhe zhǎo xié , shēngyīn cóng ménkǒu gǔn guòqù , liúxià hěn cháng de yíduàn ānjìng .
pairs.english: Someone laughed while looking for shoes in the corridor, the sound rolling past the door and leaving a long silence.
pairs.hanzi: 走廊里有人笑着找鞋，声音从门口滚过去，留下很长的一段安静。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dītóu kànzhe cèzǐ , hūrán fāxiànzìjǐ qiǎng zhe jiěshì de yàngzi , gēn dìyīcì dào xuégōng shí méishénme liǎngyàng .
pairs.english: Looking down at the book, Tavi realized his hasty explanation was just like his first arrival at the academy.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维低头看着册子，忽然发现自己抢着解释的样子，跟第一次到学宫时没什么两样。

pairs.target: shào lǐ dǎkāi lìngyìzhī bùbāo , náchū jǐgēn duǎnshéng chóngxīn zhājǐn .
pairs.english: Shaoli opened another cloth bundle and retied it with short cords.
pairs.hanzi: 邵里打开另一只布包，拿出几根短绳重新扎紧。

pairs.target: " nà biǎo zuìfán de shì huàn yíliè , qiánmiàn de shù hái liúzài nǎozǐlǐ .
pairs.english: “The trouble with those tables is changing columns while the earlier numbers stay in your head.”
pairs.hanzi: “那表最烦的是换一列，前面的数还留在脑子里。

pairs.target: wǒ zǒng ná cuò . hòulái jiù yòngzhǐ dǎngzhù , zhī lù zhèngzài suàn de nà yìháng . "
pairs.english: “I kept using the wrong ones. Later I covered them with paper, showing only the row I was calculating.”
pairs.hanzi: 我总拿错。后来就用纸挡住，只露正在算的那一行。”

pairs.target: tā zhǎo lái yìzhāng jiù liànxí zhǐ , zhēzhù bànyè , ràng tǎ wéi suàn .
pairs.english: He found an old worksheet, covered half a page, and had Tavi calculate.
pairs.hanzi: 他找来一张旧练习纸，遮住半页，让塔维算。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dìyībiàn jiù bǎ dānwèi kàn cuò le . shào lǐ qiāo le qiāo xíngtou , méi xiào .
pairs.english: Tavi misread the unit on his first try. Shaoli tapped the row heading without laughing.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维第一遍就把单位看错了。邵里敲了敲行头，没笑。

pairs.target: dìèrbiàn suàn wán , dáàn luò zàicè biān qiānbǐ xiě de shù shàng .
pairs.english: The second answer matched the pencilled number in the margin.
pairs.hanzi: 第二遍算完，答案落在册边铅笔写的数上。

pairs.target: " nǐ ná zhe . lǐmiàn yǒuxiē dáàn bú duì , bié quán xìn . "
pairs.english: “Take it. Some answers are wrong. Don't trust them all.”
pairs.hanzi: “你拿着。里面有些答案不对，别全信。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn shénme shíhòu hái . tā běnlái xiǎng shuō xiàzhōu , xiǎngdào zhège rén xiàzhōu yǐjīng búzhù zhèlǐ , yòu bǎ huà yàn le huíqù .
pairs.english: Tavi asked when to return it. He'd meant to say next week, then swallowed the words, remembering Shaoli wouldn't live here then.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问什么时候还。他本来想说下周，想到这个人下周已经不住这里，又把话咽了回去。

pairs.target: " nǐ lái xī qú kànkàn bú jiù hái le ? " shào lǐ shuō , " bié tiāo huànbān de shíhòu .
pairs.english: “Bring it when you visit West Canal,” Shaoli said. “Just not at shift change.”
pairs.hanzi: “你来西渠看看不就还了？”邵里说，“别挑换班的时候。

pairs.target: ménkǒu yǒurén wèn , jiù shuō hái shū . "
pairs.english: “If anyone asks at the gate, say you're returning a book.”
pairs.hanzi: 门口有人问，就说还书。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dāying le . tāmen yìqǐ bǎ xiāngzǐ nuó dào chuáng xià , míngzǎo cái bānchūqù .
pairs.english: Tavi agreed. Together they pushed the trunk beneath the bed to await tomorrow's move.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维答应了。他们一起把箱子挪到床下，明早才搬出去。

pairs.target: xiāngdǐ mó guò dìbǎn , liúxià yìtiáo bǐ biéchù qiǎn de huī yìn .
pairs.english: Its bottom scraped the floor, leaving a paler streak through the dust.
pairs.hanzi: 箱底磨过地板，留下一条比别处浅的灰印。

pairs.target: línzǒuqián , shào lǐ hūrán jiào tā děngyīděng , bǎ nà zhī quēkǒu bēi dìguòlái .
pairs.english: As Tavi left, Shaoli called him back and handed over the chipped cup.
pairs.hanzi: 临走前，邵里忽然叫他等一等，把那只缺口杯递过来。

pairs.target: bēidǐ xiě zhe pà wò de míngzì , yǐjīng bèi shuǐpào dé zhī shèng yíbàn .
pairs.english: Pavo's name on the bottom was half washed away.
pairs.hanzi: 杯底写着帕沃的名字，已经被水泡得只剩一半。

pairs.target: yuánlái shàngcì jiè qù shèng jiànghu , yìzhí méi hái .
pairs.english: He'd borrowed it for paste and never returned it.
pairs.hanzi: 原来上次借去盛浆糊，一直没还。

pairs.target: " wǒ hái yǐwéi tā sòng nǐ le . " " tā měi huíjiàn wǒ dōu kàn yìyǎn bēizi . nǎ xiàng sòng de . "
pairs.english: “I thought he'd given it to you.” “He looks at it every time he sees me. Some gift.”
pairs.hanzi:
“我还以为他送你了。”
“他每回见我都看一眼杯子。哪像送的。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ bēizi dàihuí qǐnshì , pà wò yí jiàn biàn shēnshǒu , duān qǐlái zhàozhe chuāng kàn quēkǒu ,
pairs.english: Tavi took the cup back to their room; Pavo immediately held it towards the window and studied the chip,
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把杯子带回寝室，帕沃一见便伸手，端起来照着窗看缺口，

pairs.target: shuō zhè tàng chūmén zhìshǎo yòu duō quē le yìxiǎokuài .
pairs.english: saying it had lost at least one more piece on its travels.
pairs.hanzi: 说这趟出门至少又多缺了一小块。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ huà xué gěi tā tīng , tā xiào dé chàdiǎn bǎ bēizi zài shuāi yícì .
pairs.english: Tavi repeated the conversation; Pavo laughed so hard he almost dropped it again.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把话学给他听，他笑得差点把杯子再摔一次。

pairs.target: wǎnshàng bǔkè shí , nà běn hòu cèzǐ fàngzài tǎ wéi shǒubiān .
pairs.english: At evening catch-up class, the thick book lay beside Tavi.
pairs.hanzi: 晚上补课时，那本厚册子放在塔维手边。

pairs.target: lǎoshī ràng tāmen chóngxīn hésuàn yìzhāng jiù tú de bǐlì , tā méiyǒu jí zhe fān dáàn , xiān ná zhǐ zhēzhù bùgāi kàn de nà yìháng .
pairs.english: Asked to recalculate an old drawing's scale, he didn't rush for the answer, but covered the wrong row with paper first.
pairs.hanzi: 老师让他们重新核算一张旧图的比例，他没有急着翻答案，先拿纸遮住不该看的那一行。

pairs.target: chuāngwài de lù dēngliàngle .
pairs.english: The streetlamps outside lit up.
pairs.hanzi: 窗外的路灯亮了。

pairs.target: nài lěi lí chéng nàtiān liúxià de shōuxìn chù dìzhǐ , hé yǐjīng jìgěi sè lā de jiǎnbào dǐgǎo yìqǐ jiá zài shūdài lǐ .
pairs.english: The mailing address Nerai had left on departure and the retained briefing sent to Sela lay together in his book bag.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾离城那天留下的收信处地址，和已经寄给瑟拉的简报底稿一起夹在书袋里。

pairs.target: tā xiǎngqǐ xī qú nà bàngè zhǒng cōng de chuāngtái , bǎ yídào suàncuò de shù cādiào , jiēzhe wǎng xià xiě .
pairs.english: Thinking of that half-windowsill of scallions at West Canal, he erased a wrong number and kept writing.
pairs.hanzi: 他想起西渠那半个种葱的窗台，把一道算错的数擦掉，接着往下写。
